name: GoVisit Tools MCP
summary: Hosted no-key Streamable HTTP MCP server with 22 read-only tools for published GoVisit travel places, destinations and documentation.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (GitHub #42, janpopovic / GoVisit.ai / inHotel Sàrl). Same operator as govisit-agent-skills-toolkit. Public Streamable HTTP MCP at https://govisit.ai/mcp requires no GoVisit API key. JSON-RPC initialize returned 200 on 2026-11-12 (serverInfo ai.govisit/tools 1.0.0); tools/list returned 22 read-only tools. Docs say a browser GET of the endpoint returns HTTP 405 and that MCP calls share the HTTP API request quota and execution limits (exact quota figures not taken from a separately verified table). Hosted tools and returned GoVisit Data are under the GoVisit Data Use License (last updated 2026-11-08), not MIT: attributed travel-planning use is permitted; bulk extraction, resale, redistribution as a feed or dataset, and competing data products are not; OTAs, metasearch, marketplaces, booking services, and apps that monetize travel referrals need a separate agreement. Attribution form is specified in that license. Third-party/pass-through content follows source notices. The MCP server implementation is not published as a GitHub repository. Public reads need no key; your client’s own usage charges still apply.

agent_access.notes: Streamable HTTP MCP; no GoVisit API key. GET of the endpoint is documented to return 405; use a Streamable HTTP MCP client. tools/list returned 22 tools on 2026-11-12. OpenAPI describes the shared HTTP tool API.
